design_system.feel: Mission Control - professional dark theme with neon accents, holographic effects for status-critical items, clean functional areas for editing

library.name: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS 4
library.notes: shadcn/ui for complex components (sidebar, dialogs, dropdowns), custom components for domain-specific UI. All themed to Mission Control.

two_row_toolbar.row2: filter tabs/pills + status filter + view toggle

layout.row1: flex justify-between items-center h-12 px-4 border-b border-border-subtle
layout.row2: flex justify-between items-center h-12 px-4 gap-4

patterns.cards-holographic: bg-gradient-to-br from-bg-card to-bg-elevated border-border-subtle rounded-xl, status glow effect
patterns.buttons-primary: bg-accent-cyan text-bg-deep font-medium rounded-lg hover:shadow-glow-cyan transition-all
patterns.badges: inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide
patterns.forms: bg-bg-secondary border-border-default rounded-md focus:border-accent-cyan focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-cyan/50
patterns.modals: bg-bg-tertiary border-border-subtle rounded-2xl shadow-modal, overlay bg-black/50
patterns.panels: fixed right-0 w-[420px] h-full bg-bg-secondary border-l border-border-subtle z-40 animate-slide-in-right

status-bar.layout: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-12 bg-bg-secondary border-t border-border-subtle z-50 flex items-center px-4 gap-6

question-type-badges.blocking: bg-error/20 text-error text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-medium
question-type-badges.preference: bg-warning/20 text-warning text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-medium
question-type-badges.fyi: bg-accent-cyan/20 text-accent-cyan text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-medium

triage-panel.layout: fixed right-4 bottom-16 w-80 max-h-[60vh] bg-bg-tertiary border border-border-subtle rounded-xl shadow-modal overflow-hidden z-50
triage-panel.header: flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 bg-bg-secondary border-b border-border-subtle
triage-panel.footer: flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 bg-bg-secondary border-t border-border-subtle

design_system.icons: Inline SVG, stroke-based, strokeWidth=2, currentColor, sizes: 14/16/20/24px
